why: A CI checkout does not mount the design repository, and a gate that cannot read its authority would count only the pump's tables - which is exactly how `tool_equipped` survived a day unnoticed. This transcription is NOT a second authority: when the document is mounted the gate parses it and fails member by member on any difference with this list (`declared_deleted_transcription_drift`).

unnamed.why: a programme's step position has no kind of its own: the step rides a receipt in a progress state, so it is counted by that state's member (`running`) and never by a word of its own
